content:
marco: Quick heads-up — A/B launch plan for the new pricing micro-slate (we're calling it 'Paywall Optics') is live in the staging page. Need final FAQ copy and inbound routing strategy. :rocket:
elaine: Nice. Can we keep the FAQ short — 3 anchors: billing, limits, security. I updated the drafts in Figma.
kevin: I pushed a microcopy sweep for the tier names. Proposal: Starter / Scale / Enterprise -> Starter, Team, Committed. shorter, less techy. Thoughts?
sam: Team + Committed reads clearer to me. Committed implies reserved capacity, good for Dedicated messaging.
nina: Agree on names. For the calculator, we should surface 2 outputs: estimated monthly + expected 95th pct latency impact (for ops teams). Small table under results.
marco: Good call @nina — product people want cost + perf. Can we add a small blur: "predictable latency with Dedicated" in results?
kevin: I'll add that. Also changed the CTA copy to "Estimate your bill" instead of "Calculate" per the UX notes.
elaine: FAQ drafts: I trimmed down answers to one-sentence + link to docs. Example: "How do commitments work? — Commit to reserved capacity monthly; billing prorated; see docs." Want to post examples for each tier.
sam: For inbound routing, recommend: Trial leads -> SDR queue A, Estimator-conversion -> Growth AE, High-commitment forms (>=$5k) -> Enterprise AE. Add tags: "estimator", "webinar-signal".
marco: Perfect. Growth-bot, can you create two webhook tags for GA and Salesforce?
growth-bot: created tag: estimator_v1, created tag: webinar_optics_2026. Payloads sent to webhook /hooks/estimator and /hooks/webinar_signals.
kevin: UX question: When someone uses the mini-calculator, should we require an email before showing full breakdown? Current plan: partial preview, ask email for full download.
nina: Partial preview is lower friction. Make the CTA subtle: "Get detailed breakdown" -> modal ask for email. Track conversions.
marco: For the launch webinar, invite list: existing trial users + high estimator conversions in last 30d. Sam, can you coordinate the send and landing page UTM?
sam: On it. Will do two sends: 1) trial cohort, 2) estimator cohort. UTM params: ?utm_source=launch&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=paywall-optics_webinar.
eleine: typo — it's elaine :) Also, we should A/B test FAQ placement: inline vs accordion. Small sample size but could matter for conversions.
kevin: I'll wire both variants in the staging page. Variant B uses accordion.
nina: For analytics, track these events: estimator_preview_shown, estimator_email_capture, estimator_submit, faq_expand, faq_link_click.
marco: Add one more metric: "sales_handshake" when SFDC lead owner is assigned.
growth-bot: Analytics events registered in LaunchSpec: estimator_preview_shown, estimator_email_capture, estimator_submit, faq_expand, faq_link_click, sales_handshake.
sam: Timeline: copy freeze by EOD tomorrow, staging QA Wed, soft-launch Thurs, webinar registration open Friday.
marco: Cool. Last ask: can we include a tiny benchmark blurb on the page — e.g., "Typical latency: hosted API < 120ms, Dedicated < 30ms" — include source link to bench doc. Keep it conservative.
kevin: I'll add: "Benchmarks based on representative NLP workloads — see benchmark page" with link.
nina: One more microtest: tier price visibility — show price ranges vs exact dollars. Which is better for conversion? We'll A/B that too.
marco: Great. Thanks team. I'll compile tasks in the launch checklist and ping when copy is final. :thumbsup:
